import { Callout } from '@/components/docs/docs-callout';

Official PHP SDK for the lomi. payments API. Works with Laravel, Symfony, WordPress, and any PHP 8.1+ application.

<Callout type="warn">
  The PHP SDK is not on Packagist. Install it from GitHub with Composer.
</Callout>

## Installation

Add this to `composer.json`:

```json
{
  "repositories": [
    {
      "type": "vcs",
      "url": "https://github.com/lomiafrica/lomi-php-sdk"
    }
  ],
  "require": {
    "lomi/lomi-sdk": "dev-main"
  }
}
```

Then run:

```bash
composer install
```

## Quick start

```php
<?php
require_once 'vendor/autoload.php';

$lomi = new \Lomi\LomiClient(getenv('LOMI_SECRET_KEY'), [
    'environment' => 'test', // omit, or set 'live', for production
]);

$session = $lomi->checkoutSessions->create([
    'amount' => 5000,
    'currency_code' => 'XOF',
    'success_url' => 'https://yoursite.com/success',
    'cancel_url' => 'https://yoursite.com/cancel',
    'metadata' => ['order_id' => 'order_123'],
]);

header('Location: ' . $session['checkout_url']);
exit;
```

Calls return arrays. A failed request throws `\Lomi\LomiException` with the HTTP status and response body.

```php
<?php
use Lomi\LomiException;

try {
    $customer = $lomi->customers->create([
        'name' => 'Aminata Touré',
        'email' => 'aminata@example.com',
        'phone_number' => '+221771234567',
    ]);
    echo $customer['id'];
} catch (LomiException $e) {
    echo $e->getCode() . ' ' . $e->getMessage();
}
```

Use `currency_code`. The API rejects `currency` on checkout sessions.

## Webhooks

The payload field is `event`, not `type`. Verify the legacy `X-Lomi-Signature` header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body). Cast a missing header to a string before `hash_equals`. Drop events older than 300 seconds using `X-Lomi-Timestamp` (an ISO-8601 string). Skip an event `id` you have already handled. Before you fulfill, re-fetch the transaction and continue only when `transaction_status` is `completed`.

```php
<?php
$payload = file_get_contents('php://input');
$signature = (string) ($_SERVER['HTTP_X_LOMI_SIGNATURE'] ?? '');
$timestamp = (string) ($_SERVER['HTTP_X_LOMI_TIMESTAMP'] ?? '');
$secret = getenv('LOMI_WEBHOOK_SECRET');

$expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $secret);
if ($signature === '' || !hash_equals($expected, $signature)) {
    http_response_code(400);
    exit;
}

if ($timestamp === '' || abs(time() - strtotime($timestamp)) > 300) {
    http_response_code(400);
    exit;
}

$event = json_decode($payload, true);
$eventId = (string) ($event['id'] ?? '');
// Store $eventId and return early when you have already processed it.

if (($event['event'] ?? '') === 'PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED') {
    $transactionId = $event['data']['id'] ?? '';
    $transaction = $lomi->transactions->get($transactionId);
    if (($transaction['transaction_status'] ?? '') === 'completed') {
        // Fulfill the order once.
    }
}

http_response_code(200);
echo json_encode(['received' => true]);
```

`\Lomi\WebhookVerify::verify($payload, $signature, $secret)` checks that same body signature. It also accepts a `sha256=` prefix on the header and rejects an empty signature or secret.

## Laravel

Put the route in `routes/api.php` so the `web` and CSRF middleware do not run.

```php
<?php
// routes/api.php

use App\Http\Controllers\LomiWebhookController;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::post('/webhook/lomi', [LomiWebhookController::class, 'handle']);
```

```php
<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/LomiWebhookController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Lomi\LomiClient;

class LomiWebhookController extends Controller
{
    public function handle(Request $request)
    {
        $payload = $request->getContent();
        $signature = (string) $request->header('x-lomi-signature', '');
        $timestamp = (string) $request->header('x-lomi-timestamp', '');
        $secret = (string) config('services.lomi.webhook_secret');

        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $secret);
        if ($signature === '' || !hash_equals($expected, $signature)) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid signature'], 400);
        }

        if ($timestamp === '' || abs(time() - strtotime($timestamp)) > 300) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Stale event'], 400);
        }

        $event = $request->json()->all();
        if (($event['event'] ?? '') !== 'PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED') {
            return response()->json(['received' => true]);
        }

        $lomi = new LomiClient((string) config('services.lomi.api_key'));
        $transaction = $lomi->transactions->get((string) ($event['data']['id'] ?? ''));
        if (($transaction['transaction_status'] ?? '') === 'completed') {
            // Fulfill once, keyed by $event['id'].
        }

        return response()->json(['received' => true]);
    }
}
```

## WordPress

```php
<?php
add_action('rest_api_init', function () {
    register_rest_route('lomi/v1', '/webhook', [
        'methods' => 'POST',
        'callback' => 'handle_lomi_webhook',
        'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
    ]);
});

function handle_lomi_webhook(WP_REST_Request $request) {
    $payload = $request->get_body();
    $signature = (string) $request->get_header('x-lomi-signature');
    $timestamp = (string) $request->get_header('x-lomi-timestamp');
    $secret = (string) get_option('lomi_webhook_secret');

    $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $secret);
    if ($signature === '' || !hash_equals($expected, $signature)) {
        return new WP_Error('invalid_signature', 'Invalid signature', ['status' => 400]);
    }

    if ($timestamp === '' || abs(time() - strtotime($timestamp)) > 300) {
        return new WP_Error('stale_event', 'Stale event', ['status' => 400]);
    }

    $event = $request->get_json_params();
    if (($event['event'] ?? '') === 'PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED') {
        // Re-fetch the transaction and fulfill only when transaction_status is completed.
    }

    return ['received' => true];
}
```

## Client

Construct `\Lomi\LomiClient`. These properties cover the merchant API. Each method returns an array.

| Property | Examples |
| --- | --- |
| `checkoutSessions` | `create`, `get`, `list` |
| `customers` | `create`, `get`, `list` |
| `transactions` | `get`, `list` |
| `paymentLinks` | `create`, `get`, `list` |
| `products` | `create`, `get`, `list` |
| `refunds` | `create`, `get`, `list` |
| `webhooks` | `create`, `get`, `list` |
